snippet.title: The Future Project - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
The Future Project releases July 27th, 2023! Explore six unique worlds filled with dangerous enemies, secrets, and incredible powers and become the ultimate explorer. Bring forth the new era!

The Future Project will be available on Steam and the Epic Games Store.
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1839320/The_Future_Project/
EGS: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/the-future-project-f19b52
